title: The Waverly - Less than 2mi from Downtown
description:
Located just two miles from downtown, 1 mile to convention center, Music Row, Vandy, and Belmont. and blocks from cool music venues, bars, and restaurants, this home is an ideal set up for large groups needing to be close to town...and for those wanting a peaceful neighborhood to get some rest! Three floors, tons of sleeping areas, & 5 full showers!

As of August 20, 2020 Airbnb does not allow parties and events with a cap on occupancy at 16 per home.
.
(Permit number: CASR-201518940)

The space
With soaring 15 ft ceilings, the first thing you will notice is the hand carved and recently hand sanded gingerbread Victorian staircase. The house has custom trim, tile, designer touches throughout. 6! Yes six original hand carved and tile fireplaces.

The Waverly (6 bed/5.5 bath)
Main Floor - 3 beds (2 king, 1 twin), 1 1/2 baths
Bedroom 1: 1 king w/attached, shared full bath
Bedroom 2: 1 king bed and daybed w/ attached, shared full bath (also includes crib)

Second Floor - 4 beds (1 king, 1 queen, 2 full), 3 baths
Bedroom 3: 1 king bed w/attached full bath
Bedroom 4: 1 queen bed w/attached full bath
Bedroom 5: 2 full beds w/attached full bath

Basement - 3 beds (1 queen, 2 twin), 1 bath
Bedroom 6: 1 queen bed, 1 day twin trundle w/full bath and kitchenette

Guest access
You will have a key so you can come and go as you please, but your hosts are on site to help with any needs that come up
